name: smooth-cursor
title: Smooth Cursor
description: Replaces the system cursor inside an area with a spring-smoothed arrow that turns toward the direction of travel.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the area. The system cursor is replaced only inside it.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Custom cursor graphic. Defaults to an arrow that rotates toward the direction of travel.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness of the follow motion. Higher is snappier.

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping of the follow motion. Higher settles with less overshoot.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the custom cursor off and keeps the system cursor. It is also off on touch devices and under reduced motion.
